name: Medio Electronics
description: A bright catalogue electronics store: a category carousel, dark promo cards and offer pills, a deal strip with the deals' real end date, photo cards, a wide deal banner, product rails with Deal/New/Best seller badges, a compare band, trending tags and brands; a results page with a row of filter dropdowns and an All filters sheet; a two-column product page with stacked buy cards; a side-by-side compare page; a receipt-first cart.
